text: Investor suitability standards requiring independent verification of an investor's ability to evaluate complex financial products and investment risk would make wealth redundant as a proxy for sophistication in determining investor eligibility.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016 (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998097

isBasedOn.name: Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016

abstract: Such proposed investor suitability standards would require independent verification of investors' ability to evaluate highly complex financial products and investment risk, rendering wealth as a proxy for sophistication redundant for investor eligibility.54
